description: USE WHEN you want to see exactly how an earlier result was produced, or reproduce it. Returns the run manifest (tool, the arguments sent, the seed where the result has one, the data window, the release, the schema version) and the stored response of one earlier call, by request_id. Works for MCP and REST calls and needs no API token (a request_id is an unguessable capability). Entries recorded before manifests existed come back with tool and arguments marked unknown. Rerun with the same arguments to reproduce: seeds are fixed, so reruns are identical while the underlying data is unchanged.

request_id.description: request_id of an earlier response (a UUID), from any enveloped tool or the REST API.
request_id.title: Request Id

name: get_run
title: Get a recorded run (manifest + stored response)
